author: Michael Larabel
description: If you have enjoyed the more than 3,125+ news articles so far this year and 200+ Linux hardware reviews this calendar year with a lot of interesting content, running this week is the annual Phoronix Premium end-of-year / "Black Friday" promotion to help support the site while enjoying ad-free access, multi-page articles on a single page, and other benefits while helping Phoronix continue as it approaches its 23rd birthday next June. Unfortunately, this year has been the toughest yet...
title: Black Friday / End Of Year Special & The Unfortunate Ad Network Situation This Year

author: Michael Larabel
description: Linux 7.4-rc4 is out today as the newest weekly test candidate for Linux 7.4. Continuing to be fueled by AI/LLM generated bug reports and patches, the Linux 7.4 cycle remains quite active...
title: Linux 7.4-rc4 Released: "It's Huge. What A Surprise."

author: Michael Larabel
description: This week AMD sent out their latest batch of AMDGPU kernel graphics driver and AMDKFD kernel compute driver updates of work slated to land with the upcoming Linux 7.5 merge window...
title: AMD Preps More Graphics Driver Fixes For Linux 7.5, More DCN6 Enablement

author: Michael Larabel
description: The latest ISO refresh for the Arch Linux powered CachyOS distribution is now available...
title: CachyOS November 2026 Released With EAC Linux v2 Support, New Recovery Tool

author: Michael Larabel
description: Sent out today as part of the x86 fixes for the week going into Linux 7.4-rc4 are the model IDs for identifying upcoming Coral Rapids server processors and the Razor Lake client processors...
title: Intel Coral Rapids & Razor Lake Model IDs Submitted For Linux 7.4-rc4

author: Michael Larabel
description: After teasing the CachyOS Package Installer 2.0 in recent weeks, today the CachyOS developers formally rolled out the CachyOS Package Installer 2.0 update. This provides a fresh UI/UX for managing packages on this Arch Linux based distribution...
title: CachyOS Releases Package Installer 2.0 With Convenient AUR / Flatpak / AppImage Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: Following some initial Device Tree and driver preparation patches that were merged for Linux v7.4, the upcoming Linux v7.5 kernel is set to introduce initial support for Ambarella SoCs with the CV75 being the initial SoC target...
title: Linux 7.5 To Introduce Initial Mainline Support For Ambarella SoCs

author: Michael Larabel
description: Intel's pipe joiner functionality is around allowing multiple internal display pipes to be used for driving a single ultra high resolution or high refresh rate display. This allows overcoming limitations of a single display pipe by using multiple pipes -- with the four-pipe ultra joiner configuration allowing for 8K and 4K@240Hz displays. Until now though the Panel Replay and PSR2 power-savings features haven't been supported when using the joiner functionality...
title: PSR2 & Panel Replay + Pipe Joiner To Be Supported For Intel On Linux 7.5

author: Michael Larabel
description: The first Rust-based driver being developed for making use of the Linux kernel's Rust Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) interface abstractions is "clevo-laptop" and is a new driver for Clevo laptops, including those sold by TUXEDO Computers, Metabox, Sager, XMG, and others...
title: The First Rust WMI Linux Driver Being Developed Is For Clevo Laptops
